title: How to get rid of or reformat enemy state icons

posts.author: PersistentDreamerGames
posts.body:
So my game uses YED_Sideview Battler and SRD_HUDMaker plugins so it can be a little more resource intensive during the battle scene, but usually it runs well. The exception being when I get a lot of stacks of icons on multiple enemies like in the pic above. It doesn't show here because it's not animated, but each of the enemies has about 3-4 icons that the game is cycling through constantly and when combined with my plugins it slows to a crawl. I could remove the icons altogether, but then I have no way for the player to know what status effects the enemies have.
Ideally, I'm trying to see if there is a way to display them differently, like in a small row underneath the enemy, or have only highest priority one show with a popup box showing the rest when you hover over the enemy.
Checking first to make sure I didn't overlook anything. Is there a way to do this in default game or in any of Yanfly's plugins?
If not, reaching out to see if anybody knows a plugin that can do this? I have a different menu for the players so it's not an issue there, I'm mainly needing this changed on the enemies.

posts.author: rpgLord69
PersistentDreamerGames
posts.body:
That's awesome! Thank you, I'll try it out! What order would I put in your plugin?
Well I just put it at the end and it seems to be working. Thank you! Solved a giant problem for me.

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body: No – you should put that plugin towards the top of your list, because it overwrites methods without aliasing, so it'll definitely conflict with anything else that touches enemy state icons. Maybe you don't have anything else like that, so it won't matter, but who knows if you'll add something like that later? Or maybe you aren't aware that something touches it.

posts.author: PersistentDreamerGames
posts.body: Thanks for the heads up. I'll adjust.

Ok, great that it works!
Yeah, usually it's good to alias stuff, but with some extensive changes, I don't know how aliasing would work. Anyway, it won't 100% not work even if something else has to do with the state icons. Like I think one Yanfly plugin just modifies the updateFrame, which I didn't touch.

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body: I suppose I exaggerated a little, but it would 100% not work if that was placed below another plugin that touches the same functions.
